old_M24.title_zh: 元吸引子与选择条件的重建
old_M24.title_en: Meta-attractors and reproduction of selection conditions
old_M24.claim_zh: 活动后果参与重建选择该组织的条件，使其经具体承载者变化仍能接续；区分机制条件、实际边界、动力学接近及可行纠正。 新会话进一步检验精确局部目标执行怎样经制度后果进入共同损失；局部安全与共同执行保护分列。 Ren 后续提出复杂性增长与实际认知／行动能力失配的退化候选；区别需求、回应、损失与修复。
old_M24.claim_en: Consequences help reproduce conditions selecting an organization across carrier changes; distinguish mechanism conditions, formed boundaries, dynamical approach and feasible correction. A new session tests how exact local objective fidelity can lead through institutional consequences to collective loss; local safety and joint-execution protection remain distinct. Ren subsequently proposes degeneration through a mismatch between growing complexity and effective cognition/action; demand, response, loss and repair remain distinct.
old_M24.scope_zh: 原47项定理／65项审计、承载者识别40项／69项、再生网络58项／107项保持原范围。再增34项 Lean 定理／56项审计，接通实际试验、记录、判准形成与改变、相位性回返；保留误导读数导致检查失能、有限误差修复及被选择历史的识别界限。此次理论接续共新增92项定理，抵达“回返及内部证据一致不能自证判准对未试变化适当”的推论界限。变化中证据／检验关系的根据与维护仍待解释；非整个理论完成、独立验收或新增经验门槛。1,024项网络探索不是证明。 集体破坏第一构造另有32项新定理／41项审计，检查两位置阶段最优化、正且可增长吞吐下的有限到达、精确盆地及严格保护；平局失败与无法自动恢复保留。接续新增71项定理／100项审计，接通有限人口替换、内部筹资、恢复／耗尽精确分界及材料约束下的核心接续；恢复前归零、分流与缺件失败保留。到墙范围是实际征收、证据、权限与承诺的形成和维护，未宣称普遍收敛或经验对应。 新的普遍连接与当前社会诊断仍为候选，已有证明不冒充指数复杂性或必然崩溃的证明。
old_M24.scope_en: The first 47/65, carrier-diagnosis 40/69 and reproduction-network 58/107 theorem/audit results retain their scopes. A further 34 theorems/56 audits join actual trial, retained readings, acquired and revised admission and temporal recurrence; misleading-reading failure, bounded-error repair and selected-history nonidentification remain. This continuation adds 92 theorems and reaches the inference wall: recurrence and internal evidential agreement do not certify adequacy under untried changes. Warrant and maintenance of changing evidence/testing relations remain open; no whole-theory completion, independent acceptance or added empirical gate. The 1,024 network explorations are not proofs. A separate first collective-destruction construction adds 32 theorems / 41 audits for two-position stage optimization, finite arrival under positive and possibly growing throughput, an exact basin and strict protection, retaining tie failure and absent automatic recovery. The continuation adds 71 theorems / 100 audits for bounded population replacement, internally financed correction, exact recovery/destruction boundaries and material-guarded core histories. Interim loss, diversion and missing-parts failures remain. The wall is formation and preservation of actual collection, evidence, authority and commitments; universal convergence and empirical correspondence are not established. The broader implication and diagnosis of current society remain hypotheses; existing proofs establish neither exponential societal complexity nor inevitable collapse.

old_M24.title_zh: 元吸引子与选择条件的重建
old_M24.title_en: Meta-attractors and reproduction of selection conditions
old_M24.claim_zh: 活动后果参与重建选择该组织的条件，使其经具体承载者变化仍能接续；区分机制条件、实际边界、动力学接近及可行纠正。 新会话进一步检验精确局部目标执行怎样经制度后果进入共同损失；局部安全与共同执行保护分列。 Ren 后续提出复杂性增长与实际认知／行动能力失配的退化候选；区别需求、回应、损失与修复。 条件接续已证明逐前缀支持与内生回应受损，并保留可负担恢复及需求调整。
old_M24.claim_en: Consequences help reproduce conditions selecting an organization across carrier changes; distinguish mechanism conditions, formed boundaries, dynamical approach and feasible correction. A new session tests how exact local objective fidelity can lead through institutional consequences to collective loss; local safety and joint-execution protection remain distinct. Ren subsequently proposes degeneration through a mismatch between growing complexity and effective cognition/action; demand, response, loss and repair remain distinct. The conditional continuation now proves prefix support and endogenous response impairment, retaining affordable recovery and demand adjustment.
old_M24.scope_zh: 原47项定理／65项审计、承载者识别40项／69项、再生网络58项／107项保持原范围。再增34项 Lean 定理／56项审计，接通实际试验、记录、判准形成与改变、相位性回返；保留误导读数导致检查失能、有限误差修复及被选择历史的识别界限。此次理论接续共新增92项定理，抵达“回返及内部证据一致不能自证判准对未试变化适当”的推论界限。变化中证据／检验关系的根据与维护仍待解释；非整个理论完成、独立验收或新增经验门槛。1,024项网络探索不是证明。 集体破坏第一构造另有32项新定理／41项审计，检查两位置阶段最优化、正且可增长吞吐下的有限到达、精确盆地及严格保护；平局失败与无法自动恢复保留。接续新增71项定理／100项审计，接通有限人口替换、内部筹资、恢复／耗尽精确分界及材料约束下的核心接续；恢复前归零、分流与缺件失败保留。到墙范围是实际征收、证据、权限与承诺的形成和维护，未宣称普遍收敛或经验对应。 新的普遍连接与当前社会诊断仍为候选，已有证明不冒充指数复杂性或必然崩溃的证明。 回应接续新增46项定理／53项审计，涵盖明确指数需求／线性回应特例和所有可负担当期留存支持最优策略的失败；认识的实际形成及社会对应仍开放。
old_M24.scope_en: The first 47/65, carrier-diagnosis 40/69 and reproduction-network 58/107 theorem/audit results retain their scopes. A further 34 theorems/56 audits join actual trial, retained readings, acquired and revised admission and temporal recurrence; misleading-reading failure, bounded-error repair and selected-history nonidentification remain. This continuation adds 92 theorems and reaches the inference wall: recurrence and internal evidential agreement do not certify adequacy under untried changes. Warrant and maintenance of changing evidence/testing relations remain open; no whole-theory completion, independent acceptance or added empirical gate. The 1,024 network explorations are not proofs. A separate first collective-destruction construction adds 32 theorems / 41 audits for two-position stage optimization, finite arrival under positive and possibly growing throughput, an exact basin and strict protection, retaining tie failure and absent automatic recovery. The continuation adds 71 theorems / 100 audits for bounded population replacement, internally financed correction, exact recovery/destruction boundaries and material-guarded core histories. Interim loss, diversion and missing-parts failures remain. The wall is formation and preservation of actual collection, evidence, authority and commitments; universal convergence and empirical correspondence are not established. The broader implication and diagnosis of current society remain hypotheses; existing proofs establish neither exponential societal complexity nor inevitable collapse. The response continuation adds 46 theorems / 53 audits, including a specified exponential-demand/linear-response case and failure of all affordable immediate-support-optimal policies. Actual cognitive realization and societal correspondence remain open.
